senses.zh_definition: 专名候选：Jatt 可作艺名，例如音乐人 Tahir Ali 使用的艺名；尚不能确定输入的小写 jatt 是否指此人。
senses.en_definition: A possible proper-name reading: Jatt is a stage name used by musician Tahir Ali; the intended referent of the lowercase input is unresolved.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan nama khas yang dapat disahkan, Jatt ialah nama pentas pemuzik Tahir Ali; rujukan bagi bentuk input jatt belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 这是有来源支持的专名候选释义，并非 DBP 官方普通词释义。输入包没有提供定义、音节、音标或爪夷文，故不能诚实标为 official。以下组合及例句只演示艺名 Jatt 的用法，不证明小写 jatt 是普通词。[滨海艺术中心官方节目资料](https://www.esplanade.com/-/media/Esplanade/Download-Component/Press-Room/PR_Pesta_Raya_2022_ML.ashx?hash=9B5B9B58F01434E5EC85A3D0749F3228&rev=58125af467a6443fbf900d7e213b705a)

dual_scenarios.ms: Tahir Ali, yang dikenali dengan nama pentas Jatt, ialah pemuzik kumpulan Black Dog Bone.

dual_scenarios.en: Tahir Ali, known by the stage name Jatt, is a musician with Black Dog Bone.

etymology.historical_story: No Malay lexical etymology is established for the supplied lowercase form jatt. A documented cultural use is Jatt, the stage name of Tahir Ali, identified by Singapore's Esplanade as a musician with Black Dog Bone. This establishes a proper-name use, but neither explains the name's origin nor identifies the intended corpus token. [Esplanade](https://www.esplanade.com/-/media/Esplanade/Download-Component/Press-Room/PR_Pesta_Raya_2022_ML.ashx?hash=9B5B9B58F01434E5EC85A3D0749F3228&rev=58125af467a6443fbf900d7e213b705a)
